newsitem.title: UK: London freight - Brokers mostly bearish, BFI down.
newsitem.headline: London freight - Brokers mostly bearish, BFI down.

text.p: Despite a number of fresh caper and panamax fixtures reported at about steady rates, most brokers are reportedly pessimistic over immediate prospects for owners.
Grain houses in particular have relatively few orders on their books in the North Atlantic, and Argentina and Brazil have not yet become as active as many had hoped.
The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) fell eight points to 1,459.
At 1215 GMT the BIFFEX futures stood unchanged to 20 points lower. April and May were both traded last at 1,490, down 20 and 16 points respectively.
BIFFEX volume totalled 280 lots, of which 116 lots were traded on April and 110 on May.
